pages.text: Evolution chamber: $(l)melee attacks$() (zerglings, banelings, ultralisks), $(l)missile attacks$() (roaches, hydralisks, queens…) and $(l)ground carapace$(). Spire: $(l)flyer attacks$() and $(l)flyer carapace$(). Three levels each: level 2 needs a lair, level 3 a hive.

Each level of a weapons upgrade adds about a tenth of a strike (at least 1) to every strike of the units it is for; each armor level is 1 armor, taken off every strike that reaches health (light units have little armor, armored ones more; bonus damage against light or armored comes on top). Shields: 1 shield armor and a tenth more shields a level. The unit panel shows a unit's levels.

$(l)Metabolic Boost$() (Spawning Pool): Zerglings run faster (6.58 instead of 4.13)$(br2)$(l)Centrifugal Hooks$() (Baneling Nest): Banelings roll faster (4.13 instead of 3.5)$(br2)$(l)Burrow$() (Hatchery): Opens burrow for every zerg unit (the lurker burrows without it)
pages.title: Unit Upgrades

pages.text: $(l)Pneumatized Carapace$() (Hatchery): Overlords fly faster (2.63 instead of 0.9)$(br2)$(l)Adrenal Glands$() (Spawning Pool): Zerglings attack 40% faster (needs a hive)$(br2)$(l)Glial Reconstitution$() (Roach Warren): Roaches run faster (4.2 instead of 3.15; needs a lair)

$(l)Tunneling Claws$() (Roach Warren): Burrowed roaches move (needs a lair)$(br2)$(l)Grooved Spines$() (Hydralisk Den): Hydralisks: +1 range$(br2)$(l)Muscular Augments$() (Hydralisk Den): Hydralisks run faster (3.94 instead of 3.15)

$(l)Seismic Spines$() (Lurker Den): Lurkers: +2 range$(br2)$(l)Adaptive Talons$() (Lurker Den): Lurkers burrow half as fast again$(br2)$(l)Greater Spire$() (Spire): The spire grows into a greater spire: corruptors may become brood lords (needs a hive)

$(l)Neural Parasite$() (Infestation Pit): Opens the infestors' neural parasite$(br2)$(l)Chitinous Plating$() (Ultralisk Cavern): Ultralisks: +2 armor$(br2)$(l)Anabolic Synthesis$() (Ultralisk Cavern): Ultralisks run faster (4.95 instead of 4.13)
